title: A TERM-trapping child is killed after the grace period

fixture_files.checks/trapper.sh:
#!/bin/sh
trap '' TERM
mkdir -p build
echo $$ > build/trapper.pid
while :; do sleep 0.2; done

steps.sh: p=$(cat build/trapper.pid) || exit 1; i=0; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -gt 10 ]; then kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; echo "pid $p still alive"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.1; done; exit 0
